property_summary: For any depositor A and any other account B, if A deposits X and B deposits Y, then after A calls withdraw() (possibly via a reentrant attacker callback from msg.sender), the sum of balances of all accounts in the contract equals zero iff the contract's total internal balance (sum of stored balances) equals address(c).balance; the mutant that zeros the caller balance before sending can be re-entered to cause the stored balances sum to become inconsistent with address(c).balance, violating this conservation property.
change_summary: Move the state update balances[msg.sender]=0 from after the external call to before it (so balances is zeroed prior to calling msg.sender.call).
